sources.fact: LBBD81/HA Wickes Hertford Road is 1.3ha, deliverable=yes, 880-899 net dwellings and planning-permission-status pending-decision.
HA has point POINT (0.069459 51.538324) and blank geometry; point is not application red line or title polygon.
Brownfield record provides a planning-history link but retains pending-decision status; no silent conversion to permissioned is allowed.
Exact application is 24/00992/FULL at Wickes Extra, Hertford Road Retail Park, Barking.
Public consultation description referred to 880 residential flats in six buildings from 18 to 31 storeys.
Officer report states total flats were reduced from 880 to 850 during consideration of the application.
Officer recommendation was delegated grant subject to Environment Agency objection withdrawal, Mayor direction, s106 completion and conditions; this is not itself proof of an issued final permission.
Report set 8 March 2026 as s106 completion/refusal-or-extension decision point; current search did not locate an authoritative final issued decision notice.
8 September 2025 Planning Committee agenda/minutes identify Wickes Development, Hertford Road and describe the residential-led proposal.
Adopted Local Plan allocation HA Wickes has indicative net minimum capacity 899.
Adopted site-allocation proformas identify HA Wickes as a housing-led allocation; allocation is separate from application status.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; register inclusion does not grant consent.

examples.result: 24/00992/FULL is the exact Wickes application reference.
880 consultation units and 850 revised officer-report units are preserved as distinct stages.
Brownfield 880-899 range is not overwritten with 850 without a current authoritative register update.
Delegated grant recommendation subject to EA/Mayor/s106 is not treated as final issued permission.
No final permission status is manufactured from the March 2026 legal-agreement deadline.
HA point is not treated as application or title geometry.
Adopted 899 capacity is not treated as consented unit count.
Promotion remains zero pending final authoritative decision, exact site polygon and exact HMLR relation.
